country_groupings.name: EUROPEAN UNION
country_groupings.reason: country-grouping (SUMMARY_LVL=CGP), observed in raw/source_test/all_partners_imports.response.json and all_partners_exports.response.json (item 3); this is the Census EU aggregate code, used only for the eu_comparability check (validation check 7b), never as a partner in the dataset. The pipeline's own EU aggregate is computed independently under partner code 'EU'.

notes: This list is fixed evidence from the 2023-12 source test (raw/source_test/all_partners_imports.response.json, all_partners_exports.response.json, stage3_analysis.json). Acquisition re-derives the excluded set per year by scanning every partner_totals response's SUMMARY_LVL and CTY_CODE fields; any new CGP code or the reappearance of 0001 observed live in any acquired year must be added here and reported, never silently dropped nor silently new-partnered.
SUMMARY_LVL is never relied on alone (the world row's SUMMARY_LVL is DET, not CGP, per source test item 3); exclusion is by these explicit code lists.
